newsitem.title: USA: MCA Music affiliate has 2 of top 3 US albums.
newsitem.headline: MCA Music affiliate has 2 of top 3 US albums.

text.p: The Interscope Records affiliate of Seagram Co Ltd's MCA Music Entertainment Group said on Wednesday that albums it distributes held the number one and number three spots on the U.S. album charts in the week ended Dec. 8.

"Tragic Kingdom," the second release by California rock band No Doubt sold almost 229,000 copies in the week, moving into the top spot three weeks shy of a year after it first hit the charts, Interscope said. "Razorblade Suitcase" by British rockers Bush, slipped from first place to third with sales of almost 180,000, Interscope said.
Celine Dion's "Falling Into You" moved from third to second place, with sales that fell about 1,500 copies behind "Tragic Kingdom."
No Doubt and Bush record for Los Angeles-based Trauma Records, whose albums are distributed by Interscope. Dion records for Epic Records, a unit of Sony Corp.

Whitney Houston's soundtrack to the upcoming movie, "The Preacher's Wife" flew into fourth after a relatively inauspicious debut last week at 12. The album was released by Arista Records, a unit of Bertelsmann AG.
Holding at fifth was the soundtrack to the box office hit, "Space Jam," handled by Time Warner Inc's Atlantic Group.
